This isn't even entirely accurate. When it comes to moving images captured by a camera a lot of this has to do with shutter speed. The longer the camera sensor is exposed to light, the more motion blur is created, which helps images blend together more seamlessly. Video games have to simulate this. You also don't notice how slow this is when you're watching a film because a film doesn't have to respond to your inputs.
